Title: NHS GMS1, Family doctor services registration, Version 01/02, as published by an NHS practice
Kind: medical registration
Source: https://www.thefamilypracticewesterncollege.nhs.uk/media/content/files/NHS_GMS1.pdf
Fetched: 2026-11-24
Notes: An old version: NHS England replaced GMS1 with the PRF1 paper form by October 2024, and no public PRF1 PDF was found. Page 1; page 2 (organ donation) is left out. Box-only blanks (date of birth, NHS number) are written as "....". [Bnn] ids are added for scoring.
